name: Speedlink
summary: Wollongong dialup ISP ('56k digital access and Fiber Optic links to the Internet'); access plans, hosting/domains, modem sales and Half-Life game servers; defunct (SPEEDLINK COMMUNICATIONS PTY LIMITED, ACN 082 214 882).

events.details: Dialup ISP for the Wollongong area (ph. 02 4284 7766); member usage stats, access plans and customer home pages.

events.details: Acquired by Chariot Limited in FY2003-04 (2004 Annual Report: 'Speedlink Internet (Wollongong, New South Wales)'). Own content live to 10 Jan 2007; first 301 redirect 16 Mar 2007 (Wayback CDX); redirects thereafter. Domain DNS lapsed by Aug 2026.
